readerAssessments.name: Terence Dougherty
readerAssessments.acceptanceQuestion: I would advance this candidate to an interview for this job based on this cover letter and tailored resume.
readerAssessments.nonEndorsementBoundary: Fictionalized public-context analytical lens, not participation, quotation, endorsement, or a real hiring decision by Terence Dougherty.
strengths: Shows end-to-end delivery from discovery and requirements through implementation, launch, maintenance, and handoff.
